speedupSummary: Page open + snapshot: 23,679 ms (Google GSI parser stall + 12,825 ms One-Tap iframe hang) -> ~590 ms (40x faster via commit + hydrationSettleMs + injectImmediately + top-frame)
notes: Medium embeds a background Google Sign-In One-Tap iframe that stalls multi-frame document_idle injection for 12+ seconds; Browser Bridge uses domcontentloaded + snapshotFrames=top + injectImmediately (~15 ms snapshot).
Use "read_article" (~45 ms) to extract clean <article> prose and code blocks, or "search_stories".

read_article.name: read_article
read_article.description: Dismisses optional dismissible sign-in prompt and extracts clean <article> text in ~45 ms.

dismiss_meter_modal.name: dismiss_meter_modal
dismiss_meter_modal.description: Closes Medium's dismissible sign-in/app upsell overlay if a close button is present.

search_stories.name: search_stories
search_stories.description: Searches Medium stories by topic/keywords and snapshots matching articles.
